formula_description: composite = (quality^wQ * durability^wD * performance^wP) * 10, where each axis is 0-10 scale, weights sum to 1.0

calibration_products.name: Rohl Shaws Original Lancaster Fireclay Farmhouse (RC3618)
calibration_products.notes: Handcrafted English fireclay. Darwen Lancashire (individual artisan firing at 2100°F+). Apron-front farmhouse iconic form. Each sink shows slight variations — genuine handcrafted quality signal. Non-porous glazed surface resists staining and bacterial growth. Dense ceramic body outlasts owner. Limited lifetime warranty. Rohl (Fortune Brands Innovations, NYSE: FBIN). Professional consensus: the fireclay benchmark. Flat bottom is a known trade-off — some fireclay designs pool water slightly. Standard center drain.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Fortune Brands Innovations (NYSE: FBIN — owns Rohl, Moen, Perrin & Rowe, Riobel, House of Rohl)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Fortune Brands is a diversified, publicly traded home products company. Rohl brand is positioned as luxury tier within portfolio.

calibration_products.name: Kohler Whitehaven Self-Trimming Cast Iron (K-6489)
calibration_products.notes: Kohler's cast iron benchmark. Self-trimming apron-front design simplifies installation vs traditional fireclay (no custom cabinetry required). Proprietary porcelain enamel glaze — chip/burn/stain resistant. Cast iron body = massive thermal mass, inherently vibration-free, zero noise. Engineered sloped bottom for better drainage than traditional fireclay. Kohler WI USA manufacturing heritage. Limited lifetime warranty. 187 Kohler luxury listing sightings. Self-trimming overlap hides rough cabinet cuts — genuine installation advantage.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Kohler Co (private, family-owned since 1873, Kohler WI)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Private family-owned since 1873, diversified (plumbing, engines, hospitality, furniture), no going-concern risk.

calibration_products.name: Blanco IKON 33 Silgranit Composite Apron Front (401734)
calibration_products.notes: Blanco's patented Silgranit II composite (80% granite + acrylic resin). 35+ patents on material formula. Heat rated to 536°F (280°C). Scratch/stain/impact resistant. First composite apron-front sink on market. Matte finish hides marks and water spots — low maintenance. German engineering (Oberderdingen HQ). Professional consensus: 'near-indestructible.' Composite body is inherently quiet. Limited lifetime warranty. Metal transfer marks (from pots rubbing surface) are cosmetic, removable with Bar Keepers Friend.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: BLANC & FISCHER Family Holding (private, German family-owned since 1925)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: German family-owned since 1925. Market leader in composite sinks. No going-concern risk.

calibration_products.name: Kohler Cairn Neoroc Composite Undermount (K-8206)
calibration_products.notes: Kohler's Neoroc composite. Matte finish, rock-hard surface. Undermount styling. Kohler engineering applied to composite — engineered drainage slope, precise dimensions. Slightly below Blanco on composite material heritage (Silgranit has 35+ years of composite history and 35+ patents). Kohler backing provides strongest parts/accessories ecosystem. Limited lifetime warranty. Neoroc formula is proprietary but newer than Silgranit — less long-term field data.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Kohler Co (private, family-owned since 1873, Kohler WI)

calibration_products.name: Kraus Standart PRO 16-Gauge Stainless Undermount (KHU100-30)
calibration_products.notes: Best value stainless steel sink. Real 16-gauge T-304 stainless (TRU16 certified — not 'up to 16-gauge' marketing). Tight-radius corners (engineered, not zero-radius premium). NoiseDefend sound deadening technology (80%+ bottom/side pad coverage). Commercial-grade satin finish hides scratches. 10" deep basin. Engineered drain slope. Accessory-compatible (cutting board, colander available separately). Limited lifetime warranty. Plumber consensus: 'solid, thick, well-engineered' for price point. Kraus (private, primarily DTC/Amazon) — newer brand heritage than legacy plumbing manufacturers.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Kraus USA (private, headquartered in Port Washington NY)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Private, growing brand. Strong Amazon/DTC presence. Limited showroom distribution.

calibration_products.name: Kohler Caxton Oval Undermount Bathroom (K-2210)
calibration_products.notes: Kohler's most popular bathroom undermount. Standard vitreous china — fired with glass-based enamel for non-porous, hygienic surface. Clean oval form. Excellent aftermarket parts and accessories. Consistent quality — mass-produced with tight tolerances. Undermount installation. Bathroom sink Performance axis is essentially flat (all drain water adequately). Limited lifetime warranty. Kohler WI brand backing. This is THE bathroom sink benchmark — 'the Fluidmaster of bathroom sinks.'
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Kohler Co (private, family-owned since 1873, Kohler WI)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Kohler ecosystem. Massive installed base. Universal parts.

calibration_products.name: Glacier Bay All-in-One Drop-In Stainless (VT3322A08)
calibration_products.notes: Home Depot house brand. Builder-grade baseline. 22-gauge stainless (thinnest commonly sold — dents under light impact, flexes, resonates noise). Stamped from single thin sheet. No sound deadening pads or spray coating — 'tinny' noise is the #1 consumer complaint. Drop-in installation (simplest, least premium). Unknown OEM manufacturing (likely Globe Union/Foremost). Flat bottom bowls with poor drainage slope. 1-year warranty. Generic drain assembly included. Universal parts compatibility is the sole durability bright spot. Plumber consensus: 'builder-grade filler — most callbacks for flexing, noise, water pooling.'
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Home Depot exclusive brand (manufactured by undisclosed OEM, likely Globe Union/Foremost)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Home Depot backing ensures availability. Quality is builder-grade positioning.
